title: Vaishnavism Saints Tukaram
definition: Sant Tukaram (1608–1650) was a preeminent 17th-century Marathi poet-saint of the Varkari Sampradaya, central to the Bhakti movement in Maharashtra, known for his devotional 'Abhangas' that challenged caste hierarchies and ritualistic orthodoxy.
importanceInUpsc: Tukaram is a perennial favorite in UPSC History (Prelims/Mains) due to his role in socio-religious reform, the democratization of Bhakti, and his influence on Maratha identity and the rise of the Maratha Empire.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vaishnavism Saints Tukaram.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
